curriculum.subject: Mathematical Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: play games involving subtraction using digital devices and other resources

mission.title: play games involving subtraction using digital devices and other resources

interactions.prompt: Game start! A lion has 5 stars. One star zooms away. Tap how many stars stay.
interactions.feedback: Great start! 5 - 1 = 4. You earned a trail star!
interactions.retryHint: Cover one star, then count the stars still on the screen.

interactions.prompt: Watch the game move: 7 counters, take away 2 counters, leaves 5. Tap the score.
interactions.retryHint: Start with 7. Count back two: 6, then 5.

interactions.prompt: Help the monkey game! Move 3 bananas to the basket. How many of 8 bananas stay on the tree?
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap any three bananas to move them, then tap the number left.
interactions.feedback: You did it! 8 - 3 = 5. The monkey keeps 5 bananas.
interactions.retryHint: Move three bananas. Count only the bananas still on the tree.

interactions.prompt: Quick game round: 9 - 4 = ? Tap the winning score.
Number-line race! Start at 12 and jump back 3 spaces. Where do you land?
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap 12, then tap three spaces back on the number line.
interactions.feedback: Fast work! 12 - 3 = 9. You reached the finish marker.

interactions.prompt: Final game badge! At the market game, 14 oranges are on a stall. 4 are bought. How many remain?
interactions.feedback: Badge earned! 14 - 4 = 10. You are a subtraction game champion!
interactions.retryHint: Take away four, then count the oranges that remain.
